lyrics.ja: 一度きりの私の物語は
lyrics.romaji: Ichido Kiri no Watashi no Monogatari ha
lyrics.en: My once-in-a-lifetime story
lyrics.zh: 僅此一次屬於我的故事

lyrics.ja: 運命を超えて煌めくんだ
lyrics.romaji: Unmei wo Koete Kirameku n Da
lyrics.en: Will shine beyond destiny

lyrics.ja: 行こう
lyrics.romaji: Ikou
lyrics.en: Let's go

lyrics.ja: ねぇ　私より私のことを
lyrics.romaji: Nee Watashi yori Watashi no Koto wo
lyrics.en: Hey—you understand me

lyrics.ja: わかってくれるキミの存在が
lyrics.romaji: Wakatte Kureru Kimi no Sonzai ga
lyrics.en: Even better than I understand myself

lyrics.ja: 臆病で泣き虫な心に
lyrics.romaji: Okubyou de Nakimushi na Kokoro ni
lyrics.en: Onto my timid, crybaby heart

lyrics.ja: 勇気と言う魔法をかけたの
lyrics.romaji: Yuuki to Iu Mahou wo Kaketa no
lyrics.en: Cast a magic spell called courage
lyrics.zh: 施下了名為勇氣的魔法

lyrics.ja: チクタク
lyrics.romaji: Chikutaku
lyrics.en: Tick-tock

lyrics.ja: 時計の針だけが進む
lyrics.romaji: Tokei no Hari Dake ga Susumu
lyrics.en: Only the clock's hands move forward
lyrics.zh: 只有時鐘的指針在前進

lyrics.ja: 立ち止まってちゃダメだ
lyrics.romaji: Tachidomattecha Dame Da
lyrics.en: I can't stay stuck in one place

lyrics.ja: ソラ転び八起きがお決まりでしょ
lyrics.romaji: Sora Korobi Yaoki ga Okimari Desho
lyrics.en: Falling down and getting back up is the usual pattern, right?
lyrics.zh: 跌倒了再爬起來是慣例對吧

lyrics.ja: 一つ一つ重ねてきた
lyrics.romaji: Hitotsu Hitotsu Kasanete Kita
lyrics.en: One by one, I've piled them up

lyrics.ja: 大切なアルバムをめくるように
lyrics.romaji: Taisetsu na Arubamu wo Mekuru You ni
lyrics.en: Like turning the pages of a precious album

lyrics.ja: 一つ一つ叶えてきた今日まで
lyrics.romaji: Hitotsu Hitotsu Kanaete Kita Kyou made
lyrics.en: Up until today, making each one come true
lyrics.zh: 一個一個實現走到今天

lyrics.ja: その全てにキミがいてくれた
lyrics.romaji: Sono Subete ni Kimi ga Ite Kureta
lyrics.en: You were there in all of it

lyrics.ja: 終わりのない夢を
lyrics.romaji: Owari no Nai Yume wo
lyrics.en: An endless dream

lyrics.ja: ずっとずっとずっとずっと
lyrics.romaji: Zutto Zutto Zutto Zutto
lyrics.en: Forever and ever and ever and ever

lyrics.ja: 追いかけて行こう　行こう
lyrics.romaji: Oikakete Ikou Ikou
lyrics.en: Let's keep chasing it—let's go

lyrics.ja: ねぇ　ここで笑い合えることが
lyrics.romaji: Nee Koko de Waraiaeru Koto ga
lyrics.en: Hey—being able to laugh together here

lyrics.ja: 何よりも大事な真実
lyrics.romaji: Nani yori mo Daiji na Shinjitsu
lyrics.en: Is a truth more precious than anything
lyrics.zh: 是比什麼都重要的真實

lyrics.ja: チクチク
lyrics.romaji: Chikuchiku
lyrics.en: Prickling

lyrics.ja: イタズラなハートが痛む
lyrics.romaji: Itazura na Haato ga Itamu
lyrics.en: My mischievous heart aches

lyrics.ja: 空回り空（そら）回り
lyrics.romaji: Karamawari Sora Mawari
lyrics.en: Spinning in circles, spinning around

lyrics.ja: 思考回路フル回転で
lyrics.romaji: Shikou Kairo Furu Kaiten de
lyrics.en: With my thought circuits at full speed

lyrics.ja: よーいどん
lyrics.romaji: Yooi Don
lyrics.en: Ready, set, go

lyrics.ja: 泣いて泣いて泣いた夜も
lyrics.romaji: Naite Naite Naita Yoru mo
lyrics.en: Even the nights I cried and cried
lyrics.zh: 哭了一整夜的夜晚也好

lyrics.ja: 大切な人生のストーリーだから
lyrics.romaji: Taisetsu na Jinsei no Sutoorii Dakara
lyrics.en: Because they're a precious story of my life

lyrics.ja: 夢を夢で終わらせたくないんだ
lyrics.romaji: Yume wo Yume de Owarasetakunai n Da
lyrics.en: I don't want my dream to end as just a dream
lyrics.zh: 不想讓夢想只停留在夢中

lyrics.ja: まだ見ぬ景色を見に行こうよ
lyrics.romaji: Mada Minu Keshiki wo Mi ni Ikou yo
lyrics.en: Let's go see landscapes we've never seen
lyrics.zh: 去看尚未見過的風景吧

lyrics.ja: もっともっと　かがやいて
lyrics.romaji: Motto Motto Kagayaite

lyrics.ja: 高く高く　飛び立とう

lyrics.en: Fly higher and higher

lyrics.ja: 奇跡さえも越えて
